query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN equipamentoId IS NULL THEN 'SEM_EQUIP' ELSE 'COM_EQUIP' END as tipo,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(14,2))), 2) as total
FROM lancamento_salario
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001 AND contaCustoId = 30004
GROUP BY tipo
